leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize and configure an API request to fetch weather data
Implement error handling for API responses and network failures
Construct a dashboard layout to display weather information
Manipulate DOM elements to render dynamic weather data
Integrate user input controls to search for different locations
Apply data transformation to format API responses for display
Bind event listeners to interactive dashboard components
lessonTitle: Build a weather dashboard using public API
